text: Three lessons of planning stop being a document and start being real infrastructure. This is the first time Terraform actually opens.

Four resources, applied together: the resource group, the primary logical server, PolicyClaimsDB, and the firewall rules -- each one a direct, traceable answer to a decision already made, not something new invented in the file.
The server is created with an Azure AD administrator and no SQL login at all -- Azure AD authentication was the plan, so it's the default here, not an afterthought.
The database comes up on a zone-redundant General Purpose tier, matching the resilience decision from last lesson. Plan runs before apply, catching any mistake before it's live.
The environment exists, empty and secured. Next: the real migration pipeline moves ten years of policy and claims data into it.
